read.thesis: Q2 CY26 record steel mill shipments (7.10Mt, utilisation 91% vs 86% in Q1) and external prices up 7% QoQ; Q3 guided higher earnings on higher steel mill pricing, though the $130M raw-material refund flatters Q2.

triggers.label: Steel mill external price +7% QoQ
triggers.quote: External Average Sales Price per Ton $1,145 $1,074 7%

triggers.label: Q3 steel mills earnings up on pricing
triggers.quote: we expect an increase in earnings due to higher realized pricing across all major product categories with stable volumes

guidance.quote: We expect higher consolidated reported earnings in the third quarter of 2026.

red_flags.label: $130M one-off raw-material refund boosts Q2 mill earnings
red_flags.quote: a reduction to cost of products sold in the amount of $130 million related to cash refunds associated with prior periods’ raw materials procurement costs

red_flags.label: Non-cash Helion gain inflates reported EPS
red_flags.quote: a non-cash, pre-tax benefit of $61 million, or $0.20 per diluted share
